thread:
Sam Torres: Morning team, I'm Sam (starting AE). Quick ramp asks: HubSpot seat, access to the CS playbook in Notion, Gong with call-tagging on, and the CSV template for bulk contact import. Also want the 'Intro sequence' copy we use for mid-market. Who's best to ping? :wave:
Leah Kim: Welcome Sam :tada: Sales Ops handles HubSpot and Notion, IT does Gong. For sequences we keep canonical copies in Notion and Drive. DM me your email and I'll start the seat flow.
Sam Torres: sent DM: sam.torres@redwood.com. Also can someone link the CSV template? I have a list to import for outreach.
Sales Enablement Bot: Automated note: canonical templates -> Notion: Sales Playbook > Sequences > Mid-Market Intro. Drive -> Sales -> Templates -> csv_import_template.csv. Create a ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEQ-IMPORT if you want Ops to run the import.
Carlos Vega: Hi Sam, I'm your onboarding buddy. Pro tip: use HubSpot sequences only after your Gong account is set to record and tag calls. That way clips map to HubSpot activities. I'll drop a starter copy of the intro email in a sec.
IT Helpdesk: Okta invite sent to sam.torres@redwood.com. Created ticket #IT-12988 for HubSpot/Gong/Drive. If Okta invite doesn't land, run:
```
okta invite resend --email sam.torres@redwood.com
okta list-users | grep sam.torres@redwood.com
```
Sam Torres: Got Okta. HubSpot SSO loops to login then says "no seat available". Notion 403. Can't download csv_import_template.csv in Drive (permission denied).
Leah Kim: Assigning HubSpot seat now  try clearing cookies and SSO again. Notion invite resent. Drive share applied. If HubSpot still shows no seat, hit "Request Access" and tag me.
IT Helpdesk: Drive permissions propagated. If you get a download error, try:
```
# gdrive quick check
gdrive auth status --user sam.torres@redwood.com
gdrive download --file-id 1a2b3c --output csv_import_template.csv
```
Sam Torres: HubSpot seat appeared after logout/login. Notion access still 403 until I opened the invite in a different browser. Drive template downloaded. Thanks! One more: can Gong auto-tag calls with "pricing" or "security" keywords? We want to surface clips for enablement.
Carlos Vega: Gong has keyword-based highlights. Enable "Call Tagging -> Keyword Rules" on your account and Sales Ops can add the shared keyword list. Tagging helps with our onboarding reviews.
Sales Enablement Bot: Request submitted to enable keyword rules and shared tag list. Tracking ID: ENABLE-4521. Note: shared keywords live in Notion > Playbook > Gong > Keywords.
Leah Kim: Also for bulk contact imports: we prefer Ops to run the import to ensure deduping and owner assignment. If you want to run it yourself, use the Drive csv_import_template.csv and follow Notion runbook: Notion > Sequences > Import Contacts > Steps.
Sam Torres: Can Ops do the import? It's ~420 contacts. Also would like the mid-market intro sequence copy you mentioned.
Leah Kim: Yep Ops can import. Please paste the CSV in the SEQ-IMPORT ticket and well queue it. Dropping the mid-market intro here: 
```
Subject: Quick intro - Redwood Inference
Hi {{first_name}},
I’m Sam from Redwood Inference. We help engineering teams run LLM inference with predictable latency and cost. Quick q: how are you handling model serving today? Can we book a 20-min call to share a short demo and cost/latency tips?
Best,
Sam
```
Use HubSpot sequence "MM-Intro-v3" (Notion has staging copy if you want to tweak).
IT Helpdesk: Gong license granted, onboarding email sent. To enable keyword rules run:
```
gong-cli features:enable --account sam.torres@redwood.com --feature keyword_rules
```
If you need call tagging permissions, reply here and we'll toggle.
Sam Torres: Please enable keyword rules and set transcript retention to 13 months. Also would like call clip download enabled for coaching.
Sales Enablement Bot: Update ENABLE-4521: keyword_rules enabled; transcript_retention set to 13 months; clip_downloads enabled for role 'AE'.
Leah Kim: Import request received. Ops will run the import and assign ownership to you. Also added you to the "Live Calls" shadow calendar and the weekly "Mid-Market Sync".
Carlos Vega: For your first week, shadow @Beth's calls Tuesday and Friday. We'll review clips in Gong and give feedback. Also check Notion > Playbook > Call Scripts > Discovery > "Latency & Cost" script.
Sam Torres: Everything works now  HubSpot, Gong, Notion, Drive template. Import ticket created SEQ-IMPORT-321. Appreciate the super fast help! :rocket:
